name: Ancient Gold Dragon
summary: A gargantuan metallic dragon that breathes fire or weakening gas, casts radiant spells, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/guiding-bolt}* (level 4 version) or (B) Weakening Breath.

actions.name: Weakening Breath

save.targets: each creature that isn't currently affected by this breath in a 90-foot Cone

actions.onFailure: The target has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts {dmg:1d10} from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

atWill.note: Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Banish

save.targets: one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet

items.onFailure: and the target has the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition and is transported to a harmless demiplane until the start of the dragon's next turn, at which point it reappears in an unoccupied space of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of the dragon.
items.onFailureOrSuccess: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Guiding Light
items.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/guiding-bolt}* (level 4 version).

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The dragon moves up to half its {ref:glossary/speed}, and it makes one Rend attack.
